Sections.SectionTitle: Provisions of Chapter 3 of Title 58.1 of the Code of Virginia to apply
Sections.Body: The income tax provisions of Chapter 3 of Title 58.1 of the Code of Virginia and the regulations promulgated thereunder shall apply to the amounts withheld by the Lottery Department, except as otherwise provided by law and 23VAC10-140-280 through 23VAC10-140-284.
Sections.Authority: §§ 58.1-203 and 58.1-4006(B)(1) of the Code of Virginia.
Sections.HistoricalNote: Derived from VR630-6-4006 § 5, eff. November 21, 1990, retroactive to September 20, 1988.
